newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Brantano IPO fixed price 1,120 Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Brantano IPO fixed price 1,120 Bfr.

text.p: The fixed price for the initial public offering of Belgian shoe distributor Brantano NV has been set at 1,120 Belgian francs per share, Brantano financial director Christine Vermeersch said on Wednesday.
The price was set following bookbuilding for institutional investors in a range of 1,030 to 1,200 francs. Retail investors can sign up from Thursday.
Institutional and retail investors can sign up for a maximum 45 percent of the capital, or 1.25 million shares.
